title: Add MOSS-Image to the app: turbo (8 steps) + SFT (25 steps), built on the FLUX.3 setup
description: Fabio approved 2026-10-22 after the MPI-1180 bench (text exact on 24/24, turbo ~6 s sampler / ~11 s per 1 MP image, ~7-8 GB warm VRAM). Run /mpi-add-model starting from MPI-1180's research/moss_image_t2i_template.json (a swapped copy of the shipped FLUX.3 raw, so boxes and the rest of the FLUX.3 plumbing carry over with few changes). Two models like Klein: toxicdog SFT-Turbo int8 (euler, CFG 1, no negative) and official SFT int8 (er_sde, CFG 2.5, empty negative). Details and open checks in brief.md.
